static_traits.name: 方明
static_traits.occupation: Currently employed; looking for a second job
static_traits.social_status: 与同为跑者的朋友关系因其对自我跑步能力的负面心态而出现紧张；Has a few supportive friends，但尚not yet与他们讨论自己的not安与not足感。
static_traits.medical_history: not yet曾就心理问题接受治疗；without显著身体疾病或既往重要病史。
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑连贯，能进行自我Reflection与合作；态度积极，但存在显著的Self-denial与与他人比较的倾向。

basic_info.main_problem: 近几个月来，我在跑步方面持续感到自我not足，尽管跑步是我喜欢的爱好。随着我希望提升跑步水平，这种not足感更明显。与社区中的其他跑者比较让我感到中度压力，每次跑步看到他人超过我就会沮丧，以至于not再从跑步中获得乐趣。我尝试过not同的训练计划与技术，但have not显著进步。
basic_info.core_demands: 这些not足感开始影响我对跑步的整体享受，并且削弱了我追求“开一家让跑步能参与其中的餐馆”的梦想的动力，因此我决定寻求咨询。

special_situations.event: Seeing other runners faster and passing me when running in the community
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能像他们一样快或至少跟上他们，就说明I am not good enough、not是好跑者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加大训练强度、尝试not同训练计划以证明自己

special_situations.event: After running, friends give positive feedback, pointing out I am improving
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有达到更高的客观成绩或名次才算“进步”，do not人的称赞not可靠
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate正面反馈，只关注自身not足
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是安慰我，这not算真正的进步

special_situations.event: Before running, thinks of possibly seeing faster runners on the track
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果without法达到他们的水平，继续跑步就have not意义
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Skips running and reduces training to avoid frustration and shame
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 反正我追not上他们，为什么还要跑？

special_situations.event: 回顾最近的训练记录时，只注意到表现not佳的几次
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Negative performance more truly reflects my level; positive experiences are just chance
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores good running experiences and positive data, strengthens attention to negative evidence
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My overall performance is poor; those few good times were just luck

core_conflict.wish: 渴望通过跑步Gaining recognition与成就感，并感到自己有价值
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被比较后显得not够好、被贬低或Being rejected，梦想因自己的not足而受挫
defense_goal: Maintaining control and proving myself through doubling training and continuous comparison
Reduces shame and frustration by skipping runs and distancing himself from running friends

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的跑者、容易自我贬低的“落后者”

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or friends give positive feedback and encourage them to attend to their own progress and positive evidence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向将他人的正面评价理解为“只是安慰”，难以相信积极证据（移情：对他人认可的not信任）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气犹疑、轻描淡写积极证据，反复以“但是/not过”开头强调not足，淡化正面体验。

manifestations: 跑步逐渐失去乐趣与意义
Every time he runs and sees others pass him, he feels frustrated
对跑步相关的梦想Decreased drive
与同为跑者的朋友Relationship tension
not yet与支持性的朋友讨论内心not足与not安
outcomes: 社交支持not yet被有效利用

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁以“I am not good enough”评价自己
negate他人的正面反馈与自己的好体验

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: 在Anticipation会感到挫败时选择跳过跑步以避免直接面对刺激
have not向支持性的朋友表达自己的not足与not安

exception_events.target_problem: 在社区跑步时，来访者通常会因与更快跑者比较而感到Low self-esteem and frustration，进而Decreased drive并偶尔跳过训练
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在少数几次跑步过程中，来访者主观感到状态Good、强壮且有能力，能够完成当次训练；跑后朋友也反馈其有所进步
exception_events.reason: not同支持：跑后朋友给予积极反馈；not同体验线索：当次跑步中主观感觉更强壮、更有掌控感

positive_force: Once had a 'strong / capable' running experience and enjoyed running
Willing to seek counseling and has a positive attitude
Current work performance satisfactory, with a certain stability and execution ability
negative_force: 习惯性与他人比较导致Self-denial
个人化与心理过滤等认知偏差Reinforcement挫败感
Decreased motivation并以跳过跑步回避训练
Sleep and overall motivation affected by negative emotions

target_behavior.behavior: Shows self-deprecation in running-related situations and avoids training (skips running)
antecedent: When seeing other community runners pass them
Before running, thinking about one's stagnant progress or others being faster
target_behavior.core_reason: 受“I am not good enough/not是好跑者”的核心信念与比较与despair、心理过滤、negate正面等认知偏差驱动，以避免羞耻与挫败
target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的情绪（Shame, frustration），短期内降低Anxiety并保护自尊
target_behavior.consequence: 失去跑步的乐趣与动力，Relationship tension，睡眠与日常活力受影响

target_behavior.behavior: negate积极反馈与自我进步迹象
antecedent: When friends give positive evaluations or point out one's progress
When reviewing training records that include both good and bad performances
target_behavior.core_reason: 对自我价值缺乏安全感，并存在“negate正面”“心理过滤”的认知偏差
target_behavior.function: Maintains a negative self-schema to avoid expectations and the disappointment that comes with them
target_behavior.consequence: 自信心难以建立，持续Self-denial，进一步降低训练动力
